ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the given food web, which is the highest organism?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food web diagram places the label "Nekton" at the top, next to a fish image. Below it are groups such as Carnivores, Grazers, Filter Feeders, Interface Feeders, Omnivores, Phytoplankton, Microphytobenthos, Detritus/Bacteria, and Deep Deposit Feeders. Several arrows lead upward toward Nekton, showing it receives energy from organisms lower in the web. Reasoning: Since the question asks for the highest organism according to the food web, I interpret "highest" as the organism shown at the top trophic/diagram level. The topmost labeled organism is Nekton.
